name: Liollmon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Chaosmon] in its name or the [ACCEL] trait and 1 Option card with the [ACCEL] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
